meta.title: Thailand DTV Visa Guide 2026: Requirements, Cost & Application (Approved)
meta.desc: Everything you need to know about Thailand's DTV (Destination Thailand Visa) for 2026. Step-by-step requirements, costs, timeline, and approved application examples from real digital nomads.

hero.title:
[2026 Guide] Thailand DTV Visa: Complete Guide
<subtag>Requirements, Costs & Real Application Documents</subtag>

intro.p1: "I want to live in Thailand long-term, but visas are complicated..." The DTV (Destination Thailand Visa) is the game-changer digital nomads have been waiting for.
intro.p2: Launched in 2024, the DTV is truly "The Digital Nomad Visa". Valid for 5 years with stays up to 180 days per entry, it officially permits remote work for international clients. In this guide, we break down everything you need to know: requirements, documents, costs, and approval tips based on real successful applications.
intro.videoNote: Watch the video breakdown (includes actual approved documents)

sec1.title: 1. What is the DTV Visa?
sec1.desc:
Official Name: "Destination Thailand Visa".
It offers unbeatable value and freedom, setting it apart from Tourist or Elite visas.

condition.label: Requirement
condition.dtv:
500k THB Savings
Proof of Freelance/Remote Work

points.title: Why DTV is a Game-Changer
points.p1: Unbeatable Value: At just 1/90th the cost of the Elite Visa, it's incredibly affordable.
points.p2: Family-Friendly: Spouses and children qualify for DTV (Dependent) status too.
points.p3: Work Legally: Digital nomad remote work, previously a gray area, is now officially recognized.

sec2.title: 2. Who Can Apply?
sec2.desc: To qualify for the DTV, you must fall into one of three categories. Most digital nomads apply under (1) Workcation.

c2.title: 2. Soft Power
c2.desc: Muay Thai, Cooking, Music events, etc.

item1.title: Passport Validity
item1.desc: Must have at least 6 months remaining.

item2.title: Financial Proof (500k THB+)
item2.desc:
Bank statement in English showing ~15k USD.
<red>* "Current balance" is sufficient; no need to maintain it for months.</red>

item3.title: Employment Contract / Portfolio
item3.desc: The most critical part. Employees: Contract or letter allowing remote work. Freelancers: Service contracts or a professional portfolio.

report.label: Application Data
report.submit: Embassy: Royal Thai Consulate-General, Ho Chi Minh City
report.note: *Applied online via the Ho Chi Minh consulate while staying in Da Nang.

item2.title: Career Proof (PDF)
item2.desc: Resume (1 page), Portfolio (1 page), Service Contract

item3.title: Financial Proof (PDF)
item3.desc: Bank Statement (500k THB+ eqv), 6-month transaction history

item4.title: Location Proof (PDF)
item4.desc: Vietnam entry stamp, Hotel booking confirmation

sec4.title: 4. Application Steps
sec4.desc: If applying outside Thailand, the process is fully online (E-Visa). No embassy visit required.

step1.title: STEP 1: Prepare Documents
step1.desc: Convert all files to PDF or JPG. Use English filenames (e.g., `Bank_Statement.pdf`).

step3.title: STEP 3: Fill & Upload
step3.desc:
Complete the forms.
Select "Destination Thailand Visa" as the visa type.

step4.title: STEP 4: Payment
step4.desc: Pay the 10,000 THB fee via credit card. Processing takes 3 days to 2-3 weeks. Apply well in advance.

step5.title: STEP 5: Approval
step5.desc: You will receive the visa as a PDF via email. Print it out and keep it with your passport.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Q. Can I apply from within Thailand?
faq.a1: A. No. You must be outside Thailand to apply. If you're currently in Thailand on a visa exemption, you'll need to travel to a neighboring country (e.g., Laos, Malaysia, Vietnam) to submit your application.
faq.q2: Q. What are the tax implications?
faq.a2: A. Staying over 180 days in a calendar year makes you a Thai tax resident. Under the new 2024 rules, foreign income brought into Thailand is taxable. Consult a tax professional for specifics.
faq.a3: A. You have two options: extend for another 180 days at a local Immigration Office (10,000 THB fee), or leave Thailand and re-enter. Re-entering grants a fresh 180-day stay (repeatable for 5 years).
